text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Excellent work, Trainer! What you've<n>achieved
with your team is truly<n>incredible!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the runners grow this much...<n>It's so
touching!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see all the things<n>they'll accomplish,
so I brought a little<n>something to help. Please, take
this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The thoughtful gift from Tazuna gets<n>the team extra
fired up to win the<n>Unity Cup!
